tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans substantial sink gradients, but its five observations leave genuine ambiguity among competing sink-dependent laws. The open-branch probe is the least costly targeted way to distinguish them before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the two-layer siphon with a positive or negative square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot observations do not establish which branch, or competing sink-dependent mechanism, generalizes.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These four-parameter alternatives can be difficult to distinguish from the siphon branch on five observations.
The pilot signatures and source archive favor a static sink-dependent branch; a trajectory batch is not the most targeted discriminator.
It does not address the branch ambiguity.
